provenance: Qualitative engineering translations; user choices rather than inferred book palette roles. No universal area percentages.

tones.label: 明亮
tones.instruction: Prefer somewhat lighter values within the existing assigned hue families. Retain dark structural accents and readable shading; avoid bleaching, clipping highlights or adding light sources.
tones.mapping_note: Broad UI preference with reference candidates from the existing 12-tone catalog, not an exact NCD class or exhaustive mapping.

tones.label: 深沉
tones.instruction: Prefer somewhat deeper values within the existing assigned hue families. Retain readable highlights, hue distinctions and shadow details; do not turn the scene into night.
tones.mapping_note: Broad UI preference with reference candidates from the existing 12-tone catalog, not an exact NCD class or exhaustive mapping.

tones.label: 清色
tones.instruction: Prefer clear, relatively clean chroma within the existing assigned hue families, without neon colours, uniform saturation boosts or loss of shading.
tones.mapping_note: Broad UI preference with reference candidates from the existing 12-tone catalog, not an exact NCD class or exhaustive mapping.

tones.label: 浊色
tones.instruction: Prefer gently restrained chroma within the existing assigned hue families. Retain colour distinctions and focal readability; do not replace the palette with grey or apply a uniform haze.
tones.mapping_note: Broad UI preference with reference candidates from the existing 12-tone catalog, not an exact NCD class or exhaustive mapping.

areas.label: 主色主导、少量强调
areas.instruction: Let the assigned base family carry the main visual weight, with the assigned accent concentrated on the named existing details. Treat this as a flexible visual hierarchy, not a measured area ratio.

areas.label: 双色并重
areas.instruction: Aim for comparable visual prominence of the two assigned colour families within the named existing regions. This is a soft preference, not equal pixel coverage; if existing region sizes prevent balance, preserve the composition and report no exact-area guarantee.

areas.label: 主色＋辅助＋强调
areas.instruction: Use the explicitly bound base as the main visual weight, the explicitly bound auxiliary colour as a supporting layer, and the explicitly bound accent as concentrated emphasis. Keep this hierarchy qualitative; do not manufacture colour coverage by adding or enlarging objects.
